annotations.title: Book for a hotel guest (front desk)

description: Requires the connected Fold account of front-desk staff at a Fold partner hotel (the login must belong to the hotel's Fold business account). Books laundry pickup for a guest by room number at that hotel. billTo='hotel' (default) puts the order on the hotel's monthly Fold statement so the hotel can charge the guest's folio: no card link is sent and no card is charged. billTo='guest' sends the guest the usual card link instead and is priced at the hotel guest rates (see book_hotel_pickup); billTo='hotel' orders are priced on the hotel's Fold contract rates, with the same $49.99 hotel order minimum. Guest name, email and phone are still needed for status updates. returnPreference: same_day (bag at the desk before 9 AM), express_same_day (9 AM–noon, +$30), next_day, or flexible. This creates a real order.

guestEmail.description: For order status updates and the receipt.

guestPhone.description: E.164 or US 10-digit, for pickup/delivery texts.

hotelAccountName.description: Only needed if this login belongs to more than one partner hotel.

idempotencyKey.description: UUID recommended. Retrying with the same key returns the same booking.

notes.description: For this order only, e.g. "2 dress shirts on hangers, rush for 6 PM event".
